summary.text: Tim Reed is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 7 who took office on January 10, 2023, after serving in the state House from 2017 to 2023.
A former mayor of Brookings, he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; the June 2, 2026, Republican primary for the seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Reed earned a B.S. in economics and computer science from South Dakota State University in 1988.

His career experience includes working as the CEO and chief economic development officer of the Brookings Economic Development Corporation and as development director of the South Dakota State University Foundation.
He has also served as advisory board chairman of the Center for the Prevention of Child Maltreatment, president of the Streamlined Sales Tax Governing Board, and mayor of Brookings.
In the 2025-2026 session Reed chairs the Senate Local Government Committee and serves on the Senate Health and Human Services Committee.
